name: Light Theme Readability Hotfix
changes: Fixes Light, Arctic, and Sandstone so translucent application chrome, search fields, selectors, toolbars, tabs, cards, and other overlay-derived controls use coordinated light surfaces instead of dark Night-style overlays.

Separates true media/modal scrims from ordinary application surfaces so poster overlays, modal backdrops, playback controls, and the fullscreen viewer remain intentionally dark and readable in the three light themes.

Keeps Night, Midnight, Ocean, Emerald, Amethyst, Rosewood, Sunset, Graphite, and Aurora color palettes unchanged and preserves all v3.6.94 layout, sizing, spacing, behavior, theme persistence, and backend isolation.

Preserves the Defender-clean Picker/yEnc build pipeline, direct verified Setup updates, Automation/Wanted/Smart Import, Newsgroup Browser, Discover, Downloads, SABnzbd 5.1.2, Metadata Server v0.3.3, and Diagnostic Collector v1.0.31.
regression_guards: Only Light, Arctic, and Sandstone may change palette semantics; all nine dark theme palette blocks must remain byte-for-byte equivalent to v3.6.94.
The three light themes must route ordinary overlay-derived UI surfaces through their coordinated light surface palette and maintain readable text/control contrast.
True modal/media/image scrims must use a separate dark scrim role with explicit high-contrast text instead of reusing ordinary light-surface overlay roles.
Night fallback reconstruction must still match the exact v3.6.93 stylesheet and all twelve theme identities/persistence behaviors remain unchanged.
The Defender-clean folder-only Picker, accepted yEnc helper, direct verified-Setup updater, and installed-upgrade smoke architecture remain unchanged.
